opener_concept: Energy bills as counting units: a 2 kW heater for 3 hours racks up 6 units (kWh) at 30p each = 180p. The student reasons in whole units by common sense, then the reveal names energy (kWh) = power (kW) x time (h) and cost = energy x price; the power equations P=VI / P=I2R are named at the end.
